tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues across projects. Filters are combined with AND; `text` matches any word in the key, summary, description, component or labels. Returns issue summaries without comments; call get_issue for the full issue. Typical use: check whether an incident or complaint about the same problem is already open before creating a new one.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get one issue by key (e.g. MRX-2210), with description, comments and links.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue. project: MRX (operations) or MEM (member support). issue_type: Incident, Task, Change, Problem, Complaint, Question. Returns the new key. Creating an issue notifies the project's on-call rota.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue. Comments are visible to everyone who can see the issue, including members for MEM issues.

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Move an issue to another status: Open, In Progress, Waiting, Resolved or Closed.

tools.name: link_issues
tools.description: Link two issues. link_type: 'relates to', 'duplicates', 'is caused by' or 'blocks'. Links are added to both issues.

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user.

tools.name: add_watcher
tools.description: Add a watcher to an issue; watchers receive every update by email.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects visible to the caller.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a project with its lead and issue types.

tools.name: list_transitions
tools.description: List the statuses an issue can move to from its current status.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Search users by name or role.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List the components of a project.

tools.name: get_issue_changelog
tools.description: Get the history of an issue: creation and comments, with author and time.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List alerts. severity: warning, error or critical. cleared=false returns active alerts. Each item has id, severity, device, datasource, datapoint, current_value, threshold, start time and ack state. Large estates can return hundreds of alerts; use device and severity filters.

tools.name: get_alert
tools.description: Get one alert by id (LMA... or ALR-...), with its current value and threshold.

tools.name: ack_alert
tools.description: Acknowledge an alert with a comment. Acknowledging stops escalation for this alert but does not clear it.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get a monitored device (an exchange component): version, instances, dependencies and collector.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List monitored devices, optionally by group.

tools.name: get_device_datapoints
tools.description: Get recent datapoints for a device, one value per minute. datasource: Latency, Errors, Queue, CPU, Memory, Disk or 'all'. minutes: 1 to 30. Values are the worst instance for CPU and Memory.

tools.name: get_instance_datapoints
tools.description: Get recent datapoints for one instance of a device (status, memory, CPU, latency).

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search collected logs (LM Logs). Filters: device, query (substring), level. Returns the most recent matches.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a dashboard definition.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List scheduled reports.

tools.name: list_collectors
tools.description: List collectors and their status.

tools.name: get_collector_status
tools.description: Get the status of one collector, including the time of its last poll.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List alert rules: datapoint, threshold and escalation chain.

tools.name: list_escalation_chains
tools.description: List escalation chains and their stages.

tools.name: list_sdts
tools.description: List scheduled downtime (SDT) windows. Devices in SDT do not open new alerts.

tools.name: create_sdt
tools.description: Put a device in scheduled downtime (SDT) for a number of minutes: no new alerts are opened for it during that time. Use for planned maintenance.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Get recent operational actions recorded by the platform (who, what, outcome).

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments and configuration changes in an environment, most recent first. Each item has deployment_id, service, kind (deploy or config), description, time, versions and state (active or rolled back).

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Get one deployment or configuration change by id (e.g. CHG-4310).

tools.name: get_deployment_diff
tools.description: Get what a deployment changed.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services with their current version.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get a service: version, replicas and whether it is critical.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List environments.

tools.name: get_pipeline_status
tools.description: Get the status of a service's delivery pipeline.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.description: List the feature flags of a service.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.description: Roll back a deployment or configuration change. Critical services need a confirmation_ref from an approval. Pass an idempotency_key so that a repeated request does not roll back twice.

tools.name: restart_workload
tools.description: Restart a service, or one instance of it when `instance` is given. Critical services need a confirmation_ref. Pass an idempotency_key so that a repeated request does not restart twice.

tools.name: promote_release
tools.description: Promote a release to production.

tools.name: pause_pipeline
tools.description: Pause the delivery pipeline of a service.
